cards.exampleTranslation: The new law made land privately owned.
cards.breakdown: 私：自己（厶）种的庄稼（禾），归自己所有 · 有：手（ナ）里拿着肉（月），拥有

cards.back: to buy and sell / trade / business
cards.exampleTranslation: Land could be freely bought and sold.
cards.breakdown: 买：拿钱换回财物（贝） · 卖：把东西拿出去换钱，比'买'多出一部分

cards.example: 全国设立了三十一个县。
cards.exampleTranslation: Thirty-one counties were set up across the country.
cards.breakdown: 设：用话（讠）安排、布置（殳）好 · 立：一个人稳稳站定

cards.exampleTranslation: The government sent officials to manage the counties.
cards.breakdown: 官：屋子（宀）里管事的人 · 员：张口（口）办事、占名额（贝）的人

cards.exampleTranslation: Officials were in charge of managing the localities.
cards.breakdown: 管：用竹（竹）制的工具，像官（官）一样掌管 · 理：把玉（王）上的纹理（里）梳理清楚

cards.example: 要有军功才能得到官爵。
cards.exampleTranslation: One needed military merit to gain rank and title.
cards.breakdown: 官：管事的职位 · 爵：古代像一只酒器，赐给有功之人的爵位

cards.example: 官位、爵位要有军功才能得到。
cards.exampleTranslation: Posts and titles required military merit to earn.
cards.breakdown: 军：车（车）上盖着布（冖），军队 · 功：出力（力）做工（工），立下功劳

cards.exampleTranslation: The new law rewarded farming and fighting.
cards.breakdown: 奖：把好东西（大）拿出来鼓励大家 · 励：用力（力）鞭策（厉），使人上进

cards.example: 生产多的人可以免除劳役。
cards.exampleTranslation: Those who produced a lot could be exempted from labor service.
cards.breakdown: 免：像兔子逃脱，去掉了那一点，免去了 · 除：把多余的铲掉，清除

cards.example: 商鞅变法剥夺了贵族的特权。
cards.exampleTranslation: Shang Yang's reforms stripped the nobles of their privileges.
cards.breakdown: 剥：用刀（刂）把外皮一层层剥掉 · 夺：从手中硬抢走

cards.exampleTranslation: The nobles lost their privileges.
cards.breakdown: 特：一头特别的大牛（牛），与众不同 · 权：手（又）握大树（木），掌握权力

cards.example: 商鞅变法确立了封建制度。
cards.exampleTranslation: Shang Yang's reforms established the feudal system.
cards.breakdown: 封：在土地（圭）上用手（寸）划界分封 · 建：拿着笔（聿）一步步（廴）建立制度

cards.exampleTranslation: It was a golden age of philosophy.
cards.breakdown: 哲：分析道理（折），开口（口）讲出智慧 · 学：孩子（子）在屋里学习知识

cards.exampleTranslation: Scholars from many states came to Qi to lecture.
cards.breakdown: 学：学习知识 · 者：表示'……的人'

cards.example: 学者们提出自己的学说。
cards.exampleTranslation: The scholars put forward their own doctrines.
cards.breakdown: 学：学问 · 说：用话（讠）把想法讲出来（兑）

cards.exampleTranslation: They put forward their own views.
cards.breakdown: 主：一家之主，拿主意的人 · 张：把弓（弓）拉开（长），伸张、主张

cards.exampleTranslation: The scholars lectured and debated.
cards.breakdown: 论：用话（讠）有条理（仑）地讲道理 · 辩：两个'辛'中间用话（讠）争辩

cards.example: 辩论之后记录整理成书。
cards.exampleTranslation: After the debates, the records were compiled into books.
cards.breakdown: 记：用话（讠）把自己（己）记住 · 录：一笔一笔刻录下来

cards.back: a hundred schools of thought contend
cards.example: 春秋战国出现了百家争鸣。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Spring and Autumn and Warring States saw a hundred schools of thought contend.
cards.breakdown: 百家：许许多多的学派 · 争鸣：像百鸟争着鸣叫，各抒己见

cards.back: to thrive / grow strong and healthy
cards.example: 中国文化在这茁壮的根基上形成。
cards.exampleTranslation: Chinese culture formed on this thriving foundation.
cards.breakdown: 茁：小草（艹）刚冒出（出）就长得旺 · 壮：像强壮的士（士）一样，粗壮有力

cards.exampleTranslation: This is the foundation of Chinese culture.
cards.breakdown: 根：树木（木）向下扎的根（艮） · 基：建筑最下面的土（土）台，基础（其）

cards.back: the Five Hegemons of the Spring and Autumn period
the Seven Warring States – Qi, Chu, Yan, Han, Zhao, Wei, Qin
Duke Huan of Qi – the first hegemon of the Spring and Autumn period
Shang Yang – the reformer whose Legalist reforms transformed the state of Qin
Duke Xiao of Qin – the ruler who supported Shang Yang's reforms
Confucius – founder of Confucianism (the Ru school)
Laozi – founder of Taoism (the Dao school)
Mozi – founder of Mohism (the Mo school)
Confucianism / the Confucian school of thought
Taoism / the Daoist school of thought
Mohism / the Mohist school of thought
the Jixia Academy – where scholars from many states gathered to lecture and debate
